# Public continuous-history fixtures

Four `UNOABIT0` files, each exactly 9145 bytes, generated by
`export_continuous_real_history` in `src/lib.rs`. They use the fixed Orchard
profile and public seed/key material. Never send funds to these test keys.
Encryption uses the selected dependency profile, not the required hybrid
profile; these notes have no claimed post-quantum protection.

`history-0.bin` creates the test's 5000-nanotomi initial output. Each subsequent
bundle spends the preceding real change, charges 100 nanotomi and creates new
change. Dummy Actions are included. All outputs belong to one cumulative tree,
not four independently funded trees. The digest is the prototype fixture value
of 32 bytes of 42, not a canonical production TOS authorization transcript.
Funding proof validity does not authorize a Deposit or ShieldClaim.

The files freeze test inputs, not production vectors or wire schema. To generate
them, invoke the ignored export test with an existing empty directory:

```sh
env UNO_ABI_FIXTURE_DIR=/absolute/empty/directory CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true \
  CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/tomi/tos/build/uno/crypto/cargo-target RAYON_NUM_THREADS=48 \
  cargo test --locked --offline --release -j48 --lib \
  export_continuous_real_history -- --ignored --nocapture
```

Run from `uno/crypto` with its pinned toolchain. Missing directory settings fail;
existing files are never overwritten. The C++ `test-uno-real-history` reads these
fixed files and replays them through the real ABI and existing state components.
